title: Ada and the Hollow
author: C. M. Okafor
blurb: Orsen Crane, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
